request: match the font of the template spec
summary: Set the text in the template spec's font and size — Arial 10 pt — where it is now in the batch's body size, 9 pt: runs that name their own font or set their own 9 pt size, every style that names a font or sets 9 pt, and the document defaults — body, headers, footers, footnotes and endnotes. Symbol fonts, the East Asian font slot and text in other sizes (8 pt headers and footers, larger notes and titles) are left alone.
assumptions: the template spec's body text is Arial 10 pt; the batch's body text is 9 pt
only 9 pt text becomes 10 pt: text in any other size (8 pt headers and footers, 12 pt notes, titles) keeps it
Symbol/Wingdings runs and styles (bullets, special characters) are left alone
a run gets the new font or size only where it sets its own; otherwise it follows its style, which changes
the eastAsia font slot and the complex-script size are unchanged
whole-document formatting is applied plain, not as tracked formatting changes (decision §14.1)
